description: Source file implementing functions for converting between SharedFileRegion and IMemory objects, handling shared memory regions in Android media framework.

classes.name: MemoryHeapBase
classes.description: Represents a memory heap for shared memory regions.

classes.name: SharedFileRegion
classes.description: Structure representing a shared memory file region with file descriptor, offset, size, and writeable flag.

methods.name: convertSharedFileRegionToIMemory
methods.description: Converts a SharedFileRegion to an IMemory object, ensuring proper page alignment and memory handling.

methods.name: convertIMemoryToSharedFileRegion
methods.description: Converts an IMemory object back to a SharedFileRegion, duplicating file descriptor and calculating offset and size.

methods.name: convertNullableSharedFileRegionToIMemory
methods.description: Converts an optional SharedFileRegion to IMemory, handling nullopt case.

methods.name: convertNullableIMemoryToSharedFileRegion
methods.description: Converts an IMemory object to an optional SharedFileRegion, handling null IMemory.
